intro.name: Yui
intro.bio: I take K-beauty skincare brands from first quote to a compliant shipment across Europe and Russia/CIS. With a background in food marketing and sensory science, and a brand I founded myself, I care about how products land with real customers.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I earned a B.S. from the College of Life Sciences, focusing on food marketing and sensory science, and wrote my thesis on how origin labels shape consumer trust. During university I founded a regional food brand, HUP. After roles in quality assurance and regulatory affairs, I joined MIRAERO KOREA CO., LTD., where I manage overseas accounts in Poland, Spain, Lithuania, Italy and Russia/CIS. What I enjoy most is connecting the commercial side with the paperwork that lets a product actually cross a border. I love seeing a brand land well in a new market. My core strengths are OEM/ODM project management, EU regulatory compliance and pricing. I am open to roles in international sales and brand management.
about.paragraph2: Outside work, I trained in fashion design and still create visuals in Photoshop and Illustrator. I lived in Turin for two months and am learning Italian.
